walkthrough:
Completing both squares reveals the centre and radius squared.
Complete the square for the $x$ and $y$ terms:
$$(x^2 - 4x) + (y^2 + 6y) - 12 = 0$$
$$(x - 2)^2 - 4 + (y + 3)^2 - 9 - 12 = 0$$
$$(x - 2)^2 + (y + 3)^2 = 25$$

Identify the centre and radius:
$$\text{Centre } (a, b) = (2, -3)$$
$$\text{Radius } r = \sqrt{25} = 5$$
